Hi Olivia / Acme security team —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Great to learn more about Acme Health's use cases and your compliance requirements. As promised, a succinct follow-up with next steps and the items you asked for:

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood maintains a Type II SOC 2 report (rolling, last audit FY2025). I can share the external-facing report and an NDA'ed package if you need more details.

2) Vendor security questionnaire: attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire template. If you want, we can pre-fill most of the fields and return a completed copy.

3) Telemetry / privacy questions: brief answers below — happy to follow up on a security call.
   - Console telemetry: by default, usage telemetry in the Redwood Console includes anonymized metrics (request counts, latencies, error rates) tied to customer ids. No customer content is sent to third parties.
   - Product/docs cookie tracking: our docs site uses analytics cookies (Google Analytics) for aggregate usage; the Console uses first-party cookies for session and CSRF protection only. We provide controls for cookie consent on public docs where required.
   - GDPR/HIPAA: We support customer-controlled data residency and offer BAAs for covered PHI/healthcare customers. We also provide contractual Data Processing Addenda and standard EU SCCs on request.

Next steps I propose:
- I will attach the questionnaire (vendor_security_questionnaire_template.xlsx) and a stub SOC2 external report link.
- Marissa to pre-fill questionnaire where possible and return by EOD Thursday (2026-07-02).
- Schedule a 30-min security deep-dive w/ our security lead (Dev Patel) and your security/infosec team — propose times below.

Proposed times (PDT): Thu 2026-07-02 09:00 or Fri 2026-07-03 11:00 — let me know which works for you and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Hi Olivia —

Thanks — answers inline and I’ve attached a pre-filled questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx) with the fields we can complete immediately. Quick answers here: 

- SOC 2 scope: our Type II SOC 2 report covers the Redwood inference platform and services we operate. We rely on cloud providers for underlying infrastructure; the report identifies third-party service providers and the control boundaries. If you need an assertion of cloud provider controls, we can share supporting vendor attestations under NDA.

- Logs and PHI/PII: by default, application logs do NOT include customer content or PHI. We log request metadata (request id, timestamp, latencies, status codes) and a customer id hash for telemetry. Customers can enable additional debugging-level logs (opt-in) that may include truncated request ids; those are treated as sensitive and require elevated access and retention controls. For HIPAA customers we recommend the dedicated capacity or private deployment options to ensure additional isolation.

Attachments included: vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx, SOC2_External_Report_stub.pdf (external-facing redacted report). The drive link with controls evidence is here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2/2025-report

I will finalize any remaining vendor-questionnaire fields you send over and get them back by Thu EOD. I’ll also send a calendar invite for Fri 2026-07-03 11:00 PDT with Dev and our security lead.

Regards,
Marissa
